newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares ease further, gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares ease further, gains seen.

text.p: Latvia's stocks lost more ground on Wednesday but the downward trend was seen slowing as the official list saw more buying activity, dealers said.
Total volume came to 116,000 lats against 58,000 lats on Tuesday and the Rietumu index fell 2.05 percent to 179.59 and Saule10 was 2.25 percent down to 140.54.
"The fall has slowed down today and there are signs of buyers getting more interested in the official stocks," Leonid Ruderman, a dealers with Parekss Bank, told Reuters.
"The correction might bottom out if the buying side is strong enough in the coming days," he added.
Unibanka was the most active stock in trade of 40,100 lats as it fell 13 santimes to 3.16 lats.
Riga Shipyard had volume of 23,500 lats and it slipped three santimes to 1.30 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet showed signs of picking up as it added one santime to 1.20 lats but it had a small turnover of 800 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre led the secondary list as it saw shares worth 15,300 lats change hands. It remained stable at 1.39 lats.
Daugavpils Chain and Salacgriva95 were also in relative demand.
Daugavpils traded 8,800 lats and closed three santimes down to 2.32 lats while Salacgriva cannery lost five santimes to 4.15 lats in trade of 8,200 lats.
